title: Find the names of the top 5 uncommon cards that are legal in the 'duel' for
question: Find the names of the top 5 uncommon cards that are legal in the 'duel' format, have foreign language translations, and are not found in starter decks, ordered by their most recent ruling date.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_049
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
JOIN foreign_data f ON c.XCL_072 = f.XCL_082
JOIN rulings r ON c.XCL_072 = r.XCL_090
WHERE c.XCL_059 = 'uncommon'
  AND l.XCL_084 = 'duel'
  AND c.XCL_029 = 0
ORDER BY r.XCL_088 DESC
LIMIT 5

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT c.XCL_049
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
JOIN foreign_data f ON c.XCL_072 = f.XCL_082
JOIN rulings r ON c.XCL_072 = r.XCL_090
WHERE c.XCL_059 = 'uncommon'
  AND l.XCL_084 = 'duel'
  AND c.XCL_072 NOT IN (
    SELECT c2.XCL_072
    FROM cards c2
    JOIN sets s ON c2.XCL_007 = s.XCL_099
    WHERE s.XCL_115 = 'starter'
  )
ORDER BY r.XCL_088 DESC
LIMIT 5
